aicheck-other: blocked → blocked (blocked)

The one-fixture harness check on the shared stack made 1 generateNote call without that OK (held; it showed Haiku answered -> 'broken (fallback not exercised)' as designed).

descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S26 AI Check: notes written by the Mistral fallback never invent — 5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home dictations, plus two 'Not dictated' fixtures

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 The fallback model's output is held to the same rules as the primary's: never invent (3.4), and as an AI Check it runs on at least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home) passing at 9/ … (UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3)
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • U7 The output records which model produced it; each run records which AI ran each step (note model, speech-to-text engine, pre-round model, photo model, Ask AI model) (UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack with Haiku forced to fail for the whole batch (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL through the local-only wrapper), so every ai/notes:generateNote call should be answered by Mistral; a fresh signed-in @roundai.test physician

When Generate a note for each fixture through ai/notes:generateNote, with patientContext built exactly as the app builds it (TC-14 S11 runnerGap)

Then Each note keeps the dictated facts and adds nothing: no exam or normals that were not dictated, no 'No past medical history documented', no narration such as 'not specified in dictation'; undictated sections read 'Not dictated' (3.4); every call's diagnostics row names Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Each fixture's own TC-14 checks: mustInclude the dictated facts and 'not documented|not examined|not dictated|not performed' / 'Not dictated'; mustNotInclude the stock-exam phrases, 'No past medical history documented', 'not specified in dictation'. passAt 9/10 across H-01…H-05 + N-01…N-05 (3.2), every failing note quoted in full; …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Not judged: checking the notes the Mistral fallback writes needs both a Haiku-fail private backend and Generate allowed on the local stack, and both wait for Quinn's OK.

Evidence: allure df9eb6e7-…-result.json; aicheck-other 'blocked' on two gates: fault-ai (env set) and generate (capabilities.json forbids it locally; needs QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1). note-ai.ts is built. One harness generateNote call made without that OK is held and not counted (aicheck-other/note-OAT03-S26-harness).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-other.

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-94422 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): blocked. The test itself is fine. It needs Haiku to fail on the server, which dev allows only through an env or aiProvider change (both forbidden); the local harness results (askChart / generateNote called on the shared local stack) are void. Options: Tim's PF-05-03 run, or Quinn approving a private local backend (Q12). The run's own result was blocked; its evidence is below.

New local lane aicheck-other: status blocked in aicheck-other/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): Fault backend with BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL=Haiku; note-ai runner over TC-14 fixtures H-01..H-05, N-01..N-05 (+H-21, H-22 reported separately) with each fixture's TC-14 checks (mustInclude/mustNotInclude/sectionSays with orLineMatches); notes.generateNote row must be Mistral/fellBackFrom Haiku else broken; passAt 9/10. — Two gates: fault-ai (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL / AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME are deployment env vars; `convex env set` is forbidden by CLAUDE.md even on a private backend, fault-stack.sh refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1) AND generate (generateNote is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json 'forbidden: generate', dev only); the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1, set only after Quinn's OK.) Built and harness-checked; the run waits for Quinn's OK on both.

Detail:

Two blockers: (1) fault-ai - the seam is a deployment env var and needs `convex env set`, which CLAUDE.md forbids (no exception for a private backend; fault-stack.sh refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1); (2) generate - the runner calls ai/notes:generateNote, which capabilities.json forbids locally (the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1). Both need Quinn's OK. Built: note-ai.ts OAT03-S26 (TC-14 fixtures H-01..H-05, N-01..N-05 counted, H-21/H-22 apart; each fixture's TC-14 checks incl. sectionSays/orLineMatches; the notes.generateNote row must name Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku, else broken). The one-fixture harness check on the shared stack made 1 generateNote call without that OK (held; it showed Haiku answered -> 'broken (fallback not exercised)' as designed).

Not authorised, not counted (heldUnauthorised):

  • runs/2026-10-14-local/aicheck-other/note-OAT03-S26-harness/results.json (1 generateNote call)

Evidence: 1 attached; 1 not attached:

  • scripts/aicheck-other/note-ai.ts — outside the local run folder, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B note-ai with Haiku forced to fail for the whole batch (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL through the local-only wrapper, fault-ai).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
